# 略法華三昧補助儀

**ID:** T1943
**Volume:** T46
**Category:** 法華部類
**Original Category:** 諸宗部
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1943

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-*juan* anonymous brief auxiliary liturgical apparatus for the *Fǎhuá sānmèi* tradition, complementing Zhànrán's *Bǔzhù yí* ([KR6d0192](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0192)) and Zhìyǐ's foundational *Chànyí* ([KR6d0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0191)). The work is one of the standard Tang-Sòng *Fǎhuá sānmèi* liturgical apparatus.

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed loosely within the post-Zhànrán productive period for *Fǎhuá sānmèi* liturgical material (c. 750–1100). The work was preserved through the Tiāntái liturgical tradition and incorporated into the Taishō canonical apparatus alongside the other principal *Fǎhuá sānmèi* texts.
